item.title: Ralph Carr, Australian Artist Manager, Unmasked as Businessman Convicted of Rape
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest updates from the world of entertainment. Today, we're discussing a shocking revelation from the Australian music industry. A well-known promoter and talent manager, Ralph Carr, has been found guilty of rape.
[Short music transition]
Host: Carr, who has guided the careers of ARIA Hall of Fame-inducted singers like Kate Ceberano and Tina Arena, was identified on August 3rd when a suppression order was lifted by the County Court of Victoria. Prosecutors alleged that Carr committed the attack against a woman at his Melbourne home in March 2023, after a night of consuming drugs and alcohol. Despite pleading not guilty, a jury found him guilty of rape and sexual assault.
[Short music transition]
Host: Carr's barrister has stated that they will appeal the verdict, with Carr maintaining his innocence. Notably, former Aussie rules football star Dustin Martin has cut ties with Carr, saying he was shocked to learn of the outcome and had no knowledge of the conduct that led to the convictions.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Ralph Carr is yet to be sentenced, and we'll continue to follow this story as it develops. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode.
[Outro music continues to play]
